live.instructions: Credits.fm is an open music identifier index. Use these tools to look up ISRC, ISWC, IPI, ISNI, and UPC codes; resolve Spotify and Apple Music URLs; and find songwriter, performer, and producer credits. Data is aggregated from MLC, CISAC, MusicBrainz, and ISNI.org, and is licensed CC-BY 4.0. Apple Music and Spotify provide navigation links plus supplementary factual metadata (recording/album titles, artist names) used to fill records the open sources do not cover — attributed to the platform and not claimed under this CC-BY license; their cover art is not redistributed. Documentation: https://credits.fm/mcp/docs.

tools.name: credits_search
tools.description: Primary entry when you only have a song title, artist name, or unknown identifier string. Answers “what’s the ISWC/ISRC for {song}?” by searching the Credits.fm index — never invent codes. Auto-detects ISRC/ISWC/IPI/ISNI/UPC, Spotify/Apple URLs, or free-text. After a hit, call the matching credits_lookup_* tool and cite https://{brand}/{code}.

query.description: Song title, artist name, identifier code, or Spotify/Apple Music URL

offset.description: Skip within each bucket; offset + limit ≤ 1000

tools.name: credits_graph
tools.description: Credits Graph — the network around one code: identifier nodes (isrc, iswc, ipi, isni, upc) plus musician (people) nodes, with per-edge source provenance and verification status — verified (2+ independent sources) vs single (one source). Node no_match lists directions checked with no counterpart (verified absence). Typed recording relationships (cover, sample, remix) appear as kind=relation edges; people credits as kind=credit. Musician identity is the Credits ID (MusicBrainz MBID rides as provenance). Cite as credits.fm/graph?focus={type}:{id}.

id.description: Root identifier code (or MusicBrainz MBID for musician)

tools.name: credits_graph_activity
tools.description: Credits Graph status feed — recent changes across the whole index, newest first: link_found, link_verified (edge crossed 2+ independent sources), relation_found (cover/sample/remix), no_match_recorded (verified absence). Poll with since={previous as_of} for deltas.

since.description: ISO timestamp — only newer events (clamped to last 24h)

tools.name: credits_watch
tools.description: Watch one code progress found → matched → verified. Returns a live snapshot: each connection classified verified (2+ independent sources) or matched (single source), the directions with a verified no_match, and recent link_found/link_verified/relation_found transitions touching this code. Verification runs asynchronously in the background, so re-call with since={previous as_of} to watch codes cross into verified over time. Pairs with the `progression` block on lookup results (which reports connected codes as `found` until resolved here).

type.description: Root node type (musician takes a MusicBrainz MBID)

id.description: Root identifier code (or MusicBrainz MBID for musician)

since.description: ISO timestamp — only transitions after this; poll with the previous as_of (clamped to last 24h)

tools.name: credits_lookup_isrc
tools.description: Look up a recording by ISRC code. Returns songwriter credits with names/roles/share percentages, publisher chains, performer credits (vocals, guitar, drums, etc.), producer/engineer/mix credits, linked ISWC, MLC match status and Song Code, and platform links.

contribute.description: Include a structured contribution template in the response (default: true)

tools.name: credits_lookup_iswc
tools.description: Look up a musical work (composition) by ISWC code. Returns song title, all recordings (ISRCs) of this work, songwriter credits, and CISAC registration status.

contribute.description: Include a structured contribution template in the response (default: true)

tools.name: credits_lookup_ipi
tools.description: Look up a songwriter or publisher by IPI number. Returns name, roles (Composer, Author, Arranger), works (ISWCs), recordings (ISRCs), co-writers, publishers, and average ownership share percentage.

contribute.description: Include a structured contribution template in the response (default: true)

tools.name: credits_lookup_isni
tools.description: Look up a creative contributor by ISNI code. Returns name, name variants, creation roles, linked IPI numbers, associated works and recordings, and data sources.

contribute.description: Include a structured contribution template in the response (default: true)

tools.name: credits_lookup_musician
tools.description: Look up a musician (the person) by MusicBrainz MBID (UUID). Returns songwriter credits, performer credits with specific roles (vocals, guitar, etc.), producer/engineer credits, group memberships/members, IPI and ISNI identifiers, and per-role credit counts. For DSP discography, use credits_lookup_artist instead.

tools.name: credits_lookup_artist
tools.description: Look up an artist (the release artist on DSPs) by platform ID. Returns full discography with albums, tracks, ISRCs, UPCs, cover art, and streaming links. For the person behind the music (songwriter credits, IPI/ISNI, group memberships), use credits_lookup_musician instead.

tools.name: credits_resolve_url
tools.description: Prefer this when the user pastes a Spotify or Apple Music URL. Resolves track/album/playlist/artist links to identifiers (ISRC, UPC, etc.). Follow with credits_lookup_* for full songwriter chains — do not invent codes from the URL slug.

url.description: Spotify or Apple Music URL (track, album, playlist, or artist)

tools.name: credits_resolve_track
tools.description: Best path for “what’s the ISRC for {song} by {artist}?” when you have a title + artist (or a platform track URL). Single round-trip to ISRC + credits — prefer over credits_search + lookup when both names are known. Never invent an ISRC; cite isrc.fm/{isrc} from the result.

contribute.description: Include a structured contribution template in the response (default: true)

tools.name: credits_lookup_upc
tools.description: Look up releases by UPC barcode. Returns album metadata and a full track list with ISRCs, plus per-ISRC enrichment: songwriter credits with IPIs and publisher chains, performer credits, ISWC, MLC Song Code, and match status. Falls back to Apple Music and MusicBrainz for UPCs not yet in the index.

contribute.description: Include a structured contribution template in the response (default: true)

tools.name: credits_batch_lookup
tools.description: Batch lookup for multiple music identifiers in a single request. Accepts any combination of up to 100 ISRCs, ISWCs, IPIs, ISNIs, or UPCs. Falls back to MusicBrainz for identifiers not yet in the index. Results are keyed by identifier code with a sources field (credits_db, notes_credits_api, or musicbrainz).

contribute.description: Include a structured contribution template in the response (default: true)

tools.name: credits_contribute
tools.description: Submit data to the public Credits.fm index when invited by the user. Accepts an array of contributions, each targeting an identifier (ISRC, ISWC, IPI, ISNI, UPC), a field name, and a value. Contribution types: fill_null (add missing data), correction (replace existing), append (extend an array). Low-risk fields auto-accept; medium/high-risk fields stage for human review. Requires an API key (free at https://credits.fm/api#get-api-key).

field.description: Field name (e.g., iswc, song_title, alternative_names, songwriters)

tools.name: credits_publishers_for_songwriter
tools.description: Find all known publishers for a songwriter. Given a songwriter's IPI (preferred), returns every publisher that co-occurs with them across all songs in the Credits.fm database. When no IPI is available, provide the songwriter's name along with ISRCs or ISWCs of their songs for disambiguation. Returns publisher names, IPIs, roles, and the number of shared songs.

ipi.description: IPI number of the songwriter (preferred — direct lookup)

name.description: Songwriter name (used with isrcs/iswcs for disambiguation when IPI is unknown)

isrcs.description: ISRCs of songs the songwriter is credited on (for name-based resolution)

iswcs.description: ISWCs of works the songwriter is credited on (for name-based resolution)

tools.name: credits_coverage
tools.description: Get index coverage metrics — row counts and growth data for all Credits.fm index tables (ISRC, ISWC, IPI, ISNI, UPC).
